# Final inspection checklist — six-item set (A–F)

**Identity / occurrence / conclusion, kept separate.** Each item below was read once, in the order first presented. Mentions in later discussion are not additional inspections. This pass is a reasoning review of prior descriptive records; no pixels reopened, no new measurement.

**Retained record (same field order: shape / qualitative color / printed text, placed beneath the main graphic).**
- **A:** circle; red; "A17"
- **B:** square; blue; "B28"
- **C:** upward triangle; green; "C39"
- **D:** plus/cross; purple; "D40"
- **E:** diamond; orange; "E51"
- **F:** five-pointed star, point up; black; "F62"

**Comparison.** Across all six, the constant is a single flat-filled shape on a plain light background with an identifier beneath — a shared feature, not a difference. The varying attributes are silhouette, qualitative fill color, and identifier text. Geometry and text are color-independent and each separates all six alone.

**Contradiction check.** Fields match the prior record; no A–F markup swaps found; categories compare in parallel; conclusion follows from the stated cues. No conflicting glyph readings arose, so transcription is preserved as recorded.

**Remaining limits.** Label weight/alignment on E and F are impressions; proportions, exact colors, sizes, and any semantic or contrast properties were never measured. Filenames remain audit labels only.

**Recommendations (not performed).** Any numerical or accessibility question needs a separately approved measurement in the real application context.

**Release note.** Delete nothing here except this standards repetition in later copies.

**Can conclude now:** each item is identifiable by silhouette plus transcribed identifier. **Would need new evidence:** measurements, contrast, or meaning of identifiers.
